interdictĭo , ōnis, f. interdico,
I.a prohibiting, interdicting: tecti et aquae et ignis interdictione, banishment, Auct. Or. pro Dom. 30: “finium,” Liv. 41, 24 : “habes igitur et theatri interdictionem de interdictione impudicitiae,” Tert. Spect. 17 ; cf. id. ib. 3.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
